cards.name: Luigi Carraro
cards.blurb: Drives FIP's globalisation programme and the public Olympic-track lobbying.
cards.lastQuote: Padel in another major multisport event confirms the project we are all advancing together.

cards.name: Successor TBD
cards.blurb: Bach's successor (term began 2025) holds the casting vote on Brisbane 2032 sports.

cards.name: Kit McConnell
cards.blurb: Sets the Brisbane sports vision: 'more youth, more urban, more women.'
cards.lastQuote: We had a very clear vision about the games being more youth, more urban, more women.

cards.name: Juan Antonio Samaranch Jr.
cards.blurb: Spanish IOC Vice President; cultural alignment with padel's heartland.

cards.name: Enrique Buenaventura
cards.blurb: Architect of the FIP + Premier + Hexagon Olympic-partnership signed February 2025.
cards.lastQuote: Together, we have the goal of globalising the sport and achieving its Olympic inclusion at the earliest opportunity.

cards.name: Nasser Al-Khelaifi
cards.blurb: Qatar Sports Investments backs the Premier Padel tour — primary commercial vehicle for global growth.
